run_best_of_n_sampling: run best-of-N sampling on dialogue data using vLLM to generate multiple candidate outputs per input
run_vllm_generate: run vLLM LLM generate with sampling params to produce N candidate outputs for each input message
run_jsonl_data_processing: run JSONL data processing to flatten dialogue history entries into individual input records with ground truth
run_logprob_computation: run logprob computation on vLLM outputs to calculate average and sum logprobs per generated candidate
run_sample_best_of_n_cli: run the sample best of N script via Fire CLI with configurable model, temperature, and N parameters
